brief: B2B shared-inbox SaaS landing page, audience: support team leads; tone: clear, trustworthy, modern. 3 rounds agreed, this is round 1.
message: Looks clean but honestly a bit too safe. Can it feel more premium? Like Linear or Stripe.

brief: Same SaaS landing page. 3 rounds agreed, this is round 3.
message: We're close! Can you make the button pop more and also try a version with a video in the hero? And maybe a dark mode toggle.

brief: Coffee house website refresh: homepage + menu page. Keep the warm crafted feel. 2 rounds agreed, this is round 1.
message: It's nice but it doesn't feel like us. We're younger than this, our crowd is students and remote workers. But don't lose the cozy vibe!

brief: Yoga studio homepage. Audience: busy professionals 30-45. Tone: calm, premium, welcoming. 3 rounds agreed, this is round 1.
message: Hmm. It feels a bit cheap? And too busy. We want people to feel calm the moment they land. Can we also show the teachers somewhere? Love the schedule table though, people ask for it all the time.

brief: Главная страница йога-студии. Тон: спокойный, премиальный. 3 раунда, это раунд 2.
message: Стало лучше, но всё ещё как-то колхозно. Хочется дороже, но не пафосно. И можно цены сделать заметнее, а то их не видно.

brief: Real-estate listings page redesign. Goal: more inquiries, trustworthy feel. 3 rounds agreed, this is round 1.
message: Our sales team says it looks like a spam site. But they also want the HOT and -10% badges bigger because they convert. Can you make it cleaner?

expect.conflict: cleaner/less spammy vs bigger promo badges

brief: Same listings page. 3 rounds agreed, this is round 2.
message: Better. Now it's maybe too empty? Also the boss wants a map view next to the list and an AI chat assistant.

brief: Immobilien-Listenansicht, Ziel: mehr Anfragen, seriös. 3 Runden vereinbart, dies ist Runde 1.
message: Irgendwie wirkt das unseriös. Und man weiß nicht, wo man zuerst hinschauen soll. Die Farben sind auch zu laut. Bitte moderner, aber nicht kalt.

brief: Food delivery app: home + dish screens. Audience 20-35. Tone: fresh, fast, friendly. 3 rounds agreed, this is round 1.
message: It's fine but kind of generic, looks like every other delivery app. Make it more fun? And the food needs to look more appetizing.

brief: Same food app. 3 rounds agreed, this is round 2.
message: Can the Add to order button be bigger and red? Red makes people hungry. Also more white space but show more restaurants on the home screen.

expect.conflict: more white space vs more restaurants

brief: App de delivery: pantallas inicio y plato. Tono fresco y cercano. 3 rondas acordadas, esta es la ronda 1.
message: Está bien pero le falta vida. Que destaque más la comida y que sea más moderno. Ah, y ¿podemos añadir un programa de puntos?

brief: Приложение-копилка, 2 экрана, светлая тема. Аудитория 25-35. Тон дружелюбный, но надёжный. 3 раунда, это раунд 1.
message: Слишком детско. Мы же про деньги. Но эмодзи-свинку оставьте, она всем нравится.

brief: То же приложение. 3 раунда, это раунд 2.
message: Кнопка «Пополнить» теряется. И вообще хочется, чтобы глаз сразу видел, сколько я накопил. Можно ещё графики добавить?

brief: Coffee house website refresh. 2 rounds agreed, this is round 2.
message: My co-owner thinks it should be darker and moodier, I think lighter and airier. Can you do something in between? Also the text is still too small for our older regulars.

brief: SaaS landing page. 3 rounds agreed, this is round 2.
message: I'll know it when I see it. Something's just off.

brief: Yoga studio homepage. 3 rounds agreed, this is round 1.
message: Make the logo bigger, make the photos bigger, make the button bigger. Everything should be bigger! But keep it minimal.

brief: Listings page redesign. 3 rounds agreed, this is round 1. Brief says: accessible (WCAG AA).
message: Make the grey filter text lighter and smaller, it's too heavy. And the prices in red look aggressive.

brief: Liefer-App, 2 Screens. 3 Runden, dies ist Runde 3.
message: Passt fast. Kann der grüne Banner mehr knallen? Und bitte noch eine Version in Lila, unser Investor mag Lila.

brief: Web de cafetería: inicio y menú. 2 rondas, esta es la ronda 1.
message: Me gusta, pero se ve un poco anticuado y el menú no se lee bien en el móvil. Más moderno pero con alma.

brief: Savings app (Russian UI), 2 screens, light theme. 3 rounds agreed, this is round 1. Client team writes in English.
message: Feels playful, which we like, but the investors said it doesn't look like a real financial product. Can we keep it playful but more legit?
